crossRefs.note: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and…
Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
“See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who…
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind…
The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases…
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my…
Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
“Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

translations.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
translations.bsb: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
translations.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
translations.asv: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.
